tagline: Restart a nuclear plant, power AI, get paid later.

kpis.l: PJM capacity price cap — hit two auctions in a row
short of reliability need in the 2028/29 auction

lead_thesis: Constellation's growth is signed but not banked: a nuclear restart on a 2027 deadline, a grid short of power, and AI deals that pay in 2027.
lead_support: A PPA is a long-term power sales contract. A capacity auction pays plants to be available. The fix: forecast permits, prices and contract value early.

problems.heading: Restarting Three Mile Island for Microsoft — due 2027
problems.fact: The NRC cleared the restart without a full environmental review in September 2026; a Pennsylvania water permit is still pending.

calls.heading: Put a daily clock on every permit
calls.sub: One slip equals lost power revenue.

calls.heading: Pre-buy fuel, parts and staff
calls.sub: Restart work can't be rushed later.

calls.heading: Sign a second 20-year buyer at Crane
Build the data center next door
calls.sub: Sell power and land; double the margin.

problems.heading: The grid ran short — capacity hit the $325 price cap
problems.fact: The 2028/29 auction cleared at the cap and missed the reliability requirement by 6,831 MW — the first full-market miss.

calls.heading: Map data-center demand county by county
calls.sub: Find where the load is really going.

calls.heading: Bid the backstop auction with discipline
Fund new capacity behind the meter
calls.sub: Skip the queue; power the campus.

calls.heading: Buy projects stuck in the interconnection queue
calls.sub: Pay for speed; own the delay.

problems.heading: Record AI deals — but the biggest check starts in 2027
problems.fact: Roughly 920 MW of new deals signed, including Walmart and 190 MW with Amazon at Calvert Cliffs; the largest AI contract pays from June 2027.

calls.heading: Publish revenue start dates per deal
Credit-score every counterparty
calls.sub: Hyperscaler concentration is a real risk.

calls.heading: Take equity in AI campuses as part payment
calls.sub: Trade power for upside, not just bills.

calls.heading: Sell a nuclear-powered AI cloud service
calls.sub: Own the compute, not just the electrons.

booth.say: Constellation's problem is timing: permits, auctions and AI checks move on other people's clocks.
ask: How does the team track restart risk permit by permit?
What happens to guidance if a big AI deal starts late?
